name: Wound Healing (Scratch) Assay Analysis
description:
Analyze the phase-contrast scratch assay image located at '~/ImageJ_Data/raw/scratch_assay.tif'. This image shows a cell monolayer with a smooth, cell-free gap (wound).

Your task is to:
1. Open the image.
2. Segment the wound (the smooth gap) from the cells (textured region). You may need to use texture-based filters (like Variance or Find Edges) and thresholding, as simple intensity thresholding may not work on phase-contrast data.
3. Create a binary mask where the wound is white (255) and the cells are black (0).
4. Save this mask as '~/ImageJ_Data/results/wound_mask.tif'.
5. Measure the Area of the wound and save the results table as '~/ImageJ_Data/results/wound_results.csv'.
